reason: A browser-side DSH Web plugin for highlighting selected assistant text, attaching notes, sending accumulated annotations with questions, and displaying numbered model replies as hoverable chips.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中选中助手回复的文字并添加批注，随问题发送后以编号标记和悬浮芯片对应查看模型回复。
summaries.en: Annotate selected text in DSH Web, send accumulated notes with a question, and review numbered model responses through highlights and hoverable chips.

capabilities: stores multiple annotations across chat turns
sends annotation content with the user's message to the model
renders numbered highlights, markers, and hoverable annotation chips
modifies chat message display in the browser
